task_instance: Produce a full Meeting Brief (per the skill's Briefing Template, vendor-call variant) for an in-house counsel negotiator preparing for a Northwind Logistics MSA renewal call, synthesizing pasted source materials (meeting info, participant list, prior email excerpts, a CLM contract snapshot, prior meeting notes, and open questions) into meeting_brief.md, including open issues, legal considerations, talking points, decisions needed, red lines, prior follow-up, and a Preparation Gaps section.
evidence: Created source_notes.md in the work directory containing simulated but realistic inputs a legal team member would have on hand (meeting details, participants, pasted email excerpts, a CLM contract summary, prior meeting notes, open questions) since this runtime has no live calendar/email/chat/CLM/CRM connectors. Then synthesized meeting_brief.md following the skill's exact Briefing Template structure (Meeting Details, Participants table, Agenda, Background and Context, Key Documents, Open Issues table, Legal Considerations, Talking Points, Questions to Raise, Decisions Needed, Red Lines, Prior Meeting Follow-Up, Preparation Gaps), correctly cross-referencing facts across the source notes (e.g. flagged that the 60-day renewal notice deadline of 2026-10-01 falls before the meeting date, connected the Q2 on-time-delivery drop to the term-length negotiation, and surfaced the pending outside-counsel opinion on uncapped IP indemnification as both a legal consideration and a preparation gap). Verified the deliverable by reading meeting_brief.md back and confirming all template sections are present and populated with concrete, internally consistent content. No shell/code execution, no binary output, and no MCP/connector tools were used or needed for this task instance -- everything the skill's core deliverable (a synthesized text briefing document) requires is achievable with text file read/write alone, using user-supplied/pasted source material as the substitute for live connector data.
